summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K reporting a US$1.0 billion offering of 7.375% Fixed Rate Reset Limited Recourse Capital Notes, Series 7 (NVCC subordinated indebtedness), under an underwriting agreement dated September 8, 2026 with BMO Capital Markets, Barclays, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and UBS as representatives. The notes were issued under a base indenture and ninth supplemental indenture dated September 16, 2026, with Computershare Trust Company as trustee. This is an ordinary bank capital issuance rather than a special situation; the fixed-rate reset, limited-recourse and NVCC trigger features are creditor-risk considerations to monitor.
